description: This file defines the interface 'DittoHeaders' for handling headers related to commands and responses in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for retrieving metadata such as correlation IDs, content types, authorization contexts, payload mapping, acknowledgements, timeouts, and other transfer-related information.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty DittoHeaders instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DittoHeaders from a given map of headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for constructing DittoHeaders.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder initialized with specific headers from a map.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder initialized with headers from a JSON object.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a mutable builder from the existing headers for modifications.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID used to group messages.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the entity.

methods.name: getDittoContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the parsed ContentType object.

methods.name: getSchemaVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON schema version.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves authorization subjects as strings.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Retrieves the AuthorizationContext object.

methods.name: getReadSubjects
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves read subjects as strings.

methods.name: getReadGrantedSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves the set of authorization subjects granted read permission.

methods.name: getReadRevokedSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves the set of authorization subjects with revoked read permission.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the channel (twin/live) associated with the header.

methods.name: isResponseRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether a response is required for the command.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Indicates if the command should be executed as a dry run.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the originating session.

methods.name: getETag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the entity.

methods.name: getIfMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tags in the If-Match header.

methods.name: getIfNoneMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tags in the If-None-Match header.

methods.name: getInboundPayloadMapper
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the inbound payload mapper.

methods.name: getReplyTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the reply target of a command.

methods.name: getExpectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of response types expected.

methods.name: isEntriesSizeGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if the size of headers exceeds a specified size.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates headers to within a maximum size in bytes.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Retrieves requested acknowledgements associated with a command.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout duration for a command.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPut
methods.description: Retrieves metadata headers for modifications.

methods.name: isAllowPolicyLockout
methods.description: Indicates if policy lockout is permitted.
